cells.value: Data Dictionary - Koushik B K (5 tables)
Schema: core - prepared 05 Nov 2026 from 'social_media_db_all_tables_columns.xlsx' with review fixes applied

Every table, column and allowed value of Koushik B K's 5 tables (as per team allocation): notifications, outbox_events, account_data_jobs, account_data_job_steps, media_deletion_jobs. Other members' tables are not included.
New or modified compared with the original workbook. The 'Change' column says exactly what changed. Removed items are listed in 'What Changed'.
Tables -> Data Dictionary (every column) -> Value Lists (table > column > values) -> Relationships.
Every user reference is <column> UUID REFERENCES core.users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. core.users belongs to the identity team.
ON DELETE RESTRICT everywhere (except media_deletion_jobs -> profile_media SET NULL, Prajwal's table). No personal text in payloads or messages. Status lists are named CHECKs.
PK = primary key. FK = link to another table. UNIQUE = no duplicates. CHECK = rule the database enforces.
